item.description: Battery materials and technology company Talga has been granted a patent in Japan that builds on its Talnode-C product line, which combines shaping and coating methods as well as purification to make battery anode materials for use in high-power applications such as hybrid vehicles. item.title: Emobi secures funding to expand its ISO 15118-based JustPlug EV charging technology
item.description: EV charging provider Emobi has closed a $3.4-million seed funding round led by Florida Funders. The company will use the new capital to support the expansion of its proprietary seamless EV charging solution, JustPlug. item.title: Schneider Electric launches EV charging system delivering up to 720 kW with decentralized architecture
item.description: Schneider Electric has introduced Schneider StarCharge Fast 720, an EV charging system for commercial and industrial sites and fleet operators in Europe. The system delivers up to 720 kW and can charge up to 12 vehicles simultaneously, targeting higher-throughput charging as demand for eMobility grows. item.description: Sponsored by DGeo. Transporting Li-ion batteries? Make room for mastery, not mistakes.
